crossRefs.note: Therefore his servants said to him, “Let a young virgin be sought for my lord the king. Let her stand before the king…
Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone…
I gave you your master’s house, and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Israel and of Judah…

people.name: Abishag
people.line: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: He said, “Please speak to Solomon the king (for he will not tell you ‘no’), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife.”
translations.bsb: Adonijah replied, “Please speak to King Solomon, since he will not turn you down. Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king, (for he will not say ➔ thee nay,) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
translations.asv: And he said, Speak, I pray thee, unto Solomon the king (for he will not say thee nay), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife.
